name: Queridos Amigos
summary: Reserved, intelligent, and generous, Leo has achieved professional success and now lives in seclusion in Serra da Cantareira, with his young wife, Karina. He discovers he's ill and decides to reconnect with old friends from the 1970s, with whom he fought against the military regime.

name: Galvão: Olha o Que Ele Fez
summary: It accompanies Galvão on trips to important places in his career as a broadcaster. Japan, where Ayrton Senna won his third Formula 1 championship, and Brazil, his fifth, is one of them. The United States, where the Brazilian national team won its fourth championship, and Qatar, the country that hosted the last World Cup he covered on Globo, are also featured in the documentary.

previousepisode.name: Finale: Und wer hat jetzt die Macht?

name: Кузнецовы ТВ
summary: Several generations of the Kuznetsov family have been living under one roof. Vera, a mother with many children, her four children from three marriages, her current husband Vitya, a creative grandmother, and grandfather Valery Mikhalych, a former engineer at a defense enterprise, share one living space. Relatives manage to coexist without swearing until TV producers offer the family to participate in a reality show. Caught in the crosshairs of the cameras, each Kuznetsov shows his true colors.

name: Weather Hunters
summary: Weather Hunters entertains and educates kids about the impact weather has on our daily lives, and inspires young kids to pursue a future in STEM. Understanding that representation in the media matters, the series includes diverse cast, helping to make science accessible to all viewers.

name: Jinx
summary: Comedy drama about a girl with a magic cookbook

name: The Celebrity Traitors: Uncloaked
summary: Ed Gamble is joined by the latest murdered and banished players to unpack all the drama from The Celebrity Traitors.

name: Ancient Autopsy
summary: From Cleopatra to Genghis Khan, Professor Suzannah Lipscomb uses cutting-edge science and compelling detective work to reveal the truth behind the deaths of history's most famous figures.

name: Werwölfe - Das Spiel von List und Täuschung
summary: At the centre of the game show are 13 candidates who try to play a dangerous game of truth and lies with the aim of exposing the hidden werewolves before they themselves are eliminated from the game. This is because three of the participants belong to the secret ‘werewolf' trio, who are doing everything they can to remain unrecognised and strategically eliminate the other candidates. Who is lying? Who can trust whom? Who will be the next to go?

name: Die Stefan Raab Show
summary: The Stefan Raab Show (DSRS for short) is a new personality show with Stefan Raab, featuring the usual mix of stand-up comedy and film clips. In addition, the entertainer plans to address current and socially relevant topics and events each week.

name: Traitors: Игра на предатели
summary: Twenty or more strangers are gathered in the atmosphere of a majestic place where every smile can hide a deception and every trust can be a "betrayal". At the center of the game is the clash between the "Righteous," who strive to build alliances and survive – and the "Traitors," who operate in the shadows, manipulating, eliminating, and striving to remain undetected until the end.

name: Secrets in the Dark
summary: Series shedding light on unusual discoveries made in the darkest places on Earth and venturing into the realm of the supernatural, where eerie and unsettling findings turn up unexplained phenomena that challenge man's understanding of the world.

name: Chronicles of the Sperrins
summary: Charting the seasons in a wild and beautiful landscape, steeped in history and legend. From the foothills to the peaks, meet the people at the heart of mountainous mid-Ulster.

name: Blade of Vengeance
summary: After his family is massacred, Ye Zhao goes undercover as Meng Jianqing to infiltrate the imperial guard and hunt down his enemies. Trapped in deadly power struggles, he fights through betrayal and bloodshed to claim justice and carve a new future.

name: Smosh Reads Reddit Stories
summary: Shayne Topp reads insane and interesting Reddit stories, every week joined by two guests.

name: Alphablocks and Numberblocks
summary: Two worlds collide as the Alphablocks meet the Numberblocks for the very first time.

name: Eternamente Amándonos
summary: The story of Paula Bernal a music enthusiast who earns a living playing live music at bars around Mexico City. Paula meets Rogelio Iturbide the two fall madly in love, get married, and decide to move to Rogelio's hometown of Morelia, without knowing how the Iturbide family would react to their union. Once in Morelia, the lovebirds are met by Rogelio's mother, Martina Rangel a very powerful and traditional woman who the locals refer to as La Monarca de Morelia and is profoundly resistant to Rogelio's newfound cosmopolitan view on life. Martina, feeling threatened by Paula's influence over her son, declares war on her new daughter-in-law and will stop at nothing to split them up.

previousepisode.name: Estaré en cada una de las flores de mi jardín

name: Love Is a Many Splendored Thing
summary: Love is a Many Splendored Thing was adapted as a daytime drama from the 1955 movie of the same name.  The series would largely focus on the Donnelly and Elliot families.

name: Schmidt & Pocher
summary: Talkshow with Schmidt and Pocher.

name: Der kleine Mann
summary: Ruediger Bunz, a clerk in an electronic store, has to manage the struggles of being a TV starlet, after he stars as "the everyday man" in an schnaps-advert.

name: Krömer - Die internationale Show
summary: Kurt Krömer interviews various celebrities.

previousepisode.name: Dieter Landuris, Joy Denalane Wasser, Rainer Dresen (#51)

name: The Next Uri Geller
summary: Uri Geller is searching for his successor in the new ProSieben show "The Next Uri Geller " For over 35 years, he has been the world's most famous mystifier. He effortlessly bent spoons, got stopped clocks running again, and read the most secret thoughts. Anyone who follows in his footsteps will need to bring a lot to the table: exceptional skills, charisma, and entertainment qualities. Who will captivate the audience and convince Uri Geller?

name: Aas Paas
summary: Arshia seeks to reunite her family after her father leaves. She meets Dr. Saham, who carries his own struggles. Their paths intertwine as they navigate family obligations and personal happiness.

name: Nightmares of Nature
summary: Chilling tales of survival unfurl in this documentary series that captures the drama, danger and dark beauty of nature from the perspective of its prey.

name: Red Alert
summary: Red Alert follows several civilians whose stories intertwine as they experienced the atrocities of October 7, including Bat Sheva (Rotem Sela), a mother forced to flee with her two daughters as her son is taken into Gaza; Ohad (Miki Leon), a father who becomes a tragic symbol of sacrifice as he fiercely protects his family; Ayoub (Hisham Suleiman), a grieving father who loses his wife and is forced to hide with his baby behind enemy lines; Nofar (Chen Amsalem), a Border Police officer caught in the massacre and injured while defending others, alongside colleague Liat (Rotem Abuhav); Kobi (Israel Atias), an anti-terrorism officer who runs directly into hell to save his wife; and Tali (Sara Vino), a devoted mother who transforms into an unlikely hero while searching for her injured son, Itamar (Nevo Katan).

name: Crime Scene Zero
summary: In this crime-solving reality show, players take on the roles of detectives and suspects. With clues and wits, can they expose the culprit among them?

previousepisode.name: Murder of the Casino Boss II

name: Kaosun Anatomisi
summary: After his sister's sudden death, a doctor finds himself entangled with a local crime syndicate and forging a tentative alliance with its new leader.

name: Beliggenhet, beliggenhet, beliggenhet
summary: A team of three real estate agents helps people not only find their new dream home, but also sell their old one.

name: When Our Kids Fall in Love
Legenden
summary: Infiltrating a criminal empire, undercover agent Tea becomes torn between her mission and a desire to help the ringleader's girlfriend escape.

previousepisode.name: Hvad var det, du sagde, at du hed?

name: Sneaker Wars: Adidas v Puma
summary: A family feud sparks the rise of two legendary sneaker brands into a fierce global competition.

name: Jiu Ming! Wo Lao Gong Cha Xiang Si Yi
Snatched a Billionaire to Be My Husband
Gilded Bond
summary: In the Southeast Asian country of Nicara, Sheng Ze—the heir of the Chinese tycoon family conglomerate Shengye Group—returns for the funeral of his younger brother, Sheng An. Convinced that Sheng An was murdered by his personal maid, Qiao Wan, Sheng Ze vows to seize power and take revenge. Meanwhile, Shengye's current head, Sheng Huaijing, begins to test his nephew, who has returned shrouded in secrets. Was Qiao Wan acting under Sheng Huaijing's orders when she allegedly killed Sheng An? What was the true cause of Sheng An's death? Thus begins a ruthless power struggle within the wealthy Sheng family, rife with conspiracy and betrayal, entanglement and confrontation, secrets and desire. Which side will Qiao Wan ultimately choose, and will Sheng Ze succeed in taking control?

name: See the Light
summary: During the Republic of China era, in the bustling and decadent district of Shili Yangchang, a pawnshop named Crimson hides in a quiet corner of the city. Whenever a woman suffers harm, the pawnshop opens its doors to deliver justice to those who wronged her. Led by owner Si Jiali and associates Lu Jingjin and others, the pawnshop team acts as vigilantes in the night. Committed to upholding factual justice, they dedicate themselves to helping women trapped in dire situations. Yet their actions draw the attention of Detective Zhou Mu of the city police. As the detective and vigilantes confront each other, the ideals of procedural justice clash with those of moral, real-world justice. Meanwhile, as Zhou Mu hunts the members of Crimson, a long-suppressed and shocking cold case slowly resurfaces—one that seems inextricably linked to everyone involved…

name: Gone Murderer
summary: In 1994, three employees of the Yujiang Pharmaceutical Factory were brutally murdered on a typhoon night. Suspicion pointed directly to the factory's leadership—Xu Chengliang, Duan Zhigang, and Du Bin—but due to insufficient evidence, the case was shelved, becoming a lifelong regret for veteran detective Shi Guangming. Fifteen years later, Su Ran, a descendant of one of the victims, returns to Yujiang with her husband Zhao Lun under the guise of journalists. Exploiting a counterfeit-drug scandal at the pharmaceutical factory, they draw close to Xu Chengliang and the others, carefully setting the stage for revenge. Su Ran first exposes Du Bin's involvement in producing and selling fake drugs, only for Du Bin to be silenced soon after. She then provokes internal conflict by revealing an illicit affair between Duan Zhigang and Xu Chengliang's wife, leading to Duan's mysterious death. As a string of murders unfolds, Shi Guangming steps in to lead the investigation, and the situation rapidly escalates. Ultimately, through Su Ran's intricate schemes, the hidden villains meet brutal ends, none escaping their fate. Yet Su Ran herself cannot evade destiny or the law. Having fulfilled her long-awaited mission, she discovers that its end brings betrayal among allies, separation from loved ones, and the shattering realization that even the father she never doubted was nothing more than an illusion.

name: My Queen, My Rules
summary: The cold and domineering CEO, Cen Sen, and the arrogant young lady, Ji Ming Shu, go from mutual suspicion and manipulation to a life-and-death love. Throughout the process of changing their fate and saving each other, they experience a deep and passionate romance that begins with an arranged marriage.

name: Lucy Letby: Murder or Mistake
summary: Series covering the infamous murder case, following the turbulent months after the conviction and a high-profile campaign to sway public opinion. For the first time, one affected family break their silence about their experience with Letby and their newborn.

name: Death in Apartment 603: What Happened to Ellen Greenberg?
summary: Ellen Greenberg was found dead with 20 stab wounds. Philadelphia ruled it suicide. This three-part series follows her family's quest to find the truth.

previousepisode.name: The Greenbergs v. The City of Philadelphia

name: Cocaine Quarterback: Signal-Caller for the Cartel
summary: Cocaine Quarterback: Signal-Caller for the Cartel tells the unbelievable true tale of convicted drug trafficker Owen Hanson's rise from USC college football champion to smuggling for the world's most dangerous cartel.

name: Small Prophets
summary:
Small Prophets is a comic tale of eccentric Michael Sleep who, since his darling Clea disappeared seven years ago, has lived a very ordinary life. He eats Shreddies, works in a DIY store, visits dad Brian and hopes for Clea to return.

That is just the way it is, until one day dad Brian shares an old recipe involving rainwater, horse manure and more than a little alchemy. With recipe in hand, Michael sets out (albeit with some scepticism) to create Homunculi - magical prophesying spirits that can predict the future - in the hope they have the answer to his burning question, ‘will I ever see Clea again?'.

Michael gets help from young work mate Kacey, an unlikely friendship that blossoms partly (but not wholly) through their mutual dislike of store manager Gordon. Their friendship adds to the frustration and intrigue of his nosy neighbours who are obsessed with trying to find out what the hell is going on in the garden shed.

name: Shou Shen Nan Nu Zhi Zhong Liang Ji Lian Ai
Awaken
summary: In the winter of 1941, the Underground Communist Party, "Three Scenes of West Lake," is activated to counter the Imperial Japanese Army's biological warfare initiative, Project Slumber. Chen Kailai, an assistant photographer at Chunguang Photo Studio, sets off for Shanghai for a clandestine rendezvous after witnessing the death of his mentor, Li Musheng, an underground operative codenamed Broken Bridge. En route, he gets acquainted with Jinbao, a fugitive dance hostess sharing a similar plight. Aboard the train, they encounter Su Men, a special commissioner of the Wang-controlled puppet regime, and are drawn into the regime's infighting. Arriving in Shanghai, Chen opens a photo studio with Jinbao's assistance to await his contact—unaware that Jinbao is actually an agent, codenamed God of Wealth, under the nationalist military intelligence agency, NBIS. When Shen Kexi, codenamed Su Causeway, finally shows up, Chen hands over his late mentor's belongings to her and participates in underground operations. Witnessing Shen being arrested, Chen assists Zhao Qian, codenamed Leifeng Pagoda, to rescue her successfully. Determined to become a qualified underground agent, Chen takes over the codename Broken Bridge. Together with Su Causeway and Leifeng Pagoda, he carries out perilous tasks under the command of their superior codenamed Diana. Finally, Chen helps Shen sneak into the lab to steal samples, exposing the Japanese atrocities and preventing a viral disaster. However, along the way, Zhao, Shen, and Jinbao are martyred, and Chen records every moving moment with his camera.

name: Debanhi: ¿Quién mató a nuestra hija?
summary: This gripping four-part docuseries centers on the 2022 disappearance of 18-year-old Debanhi Escobar in Monterrey, Mexico.

name: Hero Without a Class: Who Even Needs Skills?!
summary:
A fantasy-adventure anime about a protagonist who is declared classless—an exceptionally rare status despite being born to a god-tier swordswoman mother and a high level mage father. Determined to prove that class doesn't define him, he pursues intense training to master both combat and spell-casting abilities, topping that of the actual class-holders.

This anime started airing a week earlier (Sep 24) on streaming services as opposed to terrestrial broadcast (Oct 1).

name: Spirit Fingers
summary:
Song U-Yeon (Park Ji-Hu) is an ordinary high school student, who isn't special in any specific thing. Her mother always put her older brother and younger brother before Song U-Yeon and her opinions are usually ignored at home. Due to this, Song U-Yeon doesn't express her feelings and she has low self-esteem.

One day, a good looking man on the street asks her to pose as a model for a group of people. The man is Koo Sun-Ho (Choi Bo-Min) and the group are members of sketch club Spirit Fingers, including their President Nam Geu-Rin (Park Yoo-Na). Song U-Yeon poses on the street for them, but, unlike Song U-Yeon, the members are full of individuality and seem to get along well. This leads Song U-Yeon to join Spirit Fingers. The members encourage and compliment Song U-Yeon, which causes her self-esteem to grow.

Meanwhile, Nam Gi-Jung (Jo Joon-Young) is Club President Nam Geu-Rin's younger brother and he is a high school student and the same age as Song U-Yeon. He has an attractive appearance and models for internet shopping malls as a part-time jpb. Due to Song U-Yeon, he begins to think about his future as a model seriously.

name: Asia Express
summary: Asia Express is the Romanian version of the reality show Peking Express that was created in 2004.

name: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill
summary: Biologist and naturalist Dan O'Neill embarks on a groundbreaking mission to protect one of the world's most elusive creatures—the snow leopard. Set against the stunning backdrop of Kyrgyzstan's rugged mountains, this two-part adventure follows Dan as he works to build a new research center dedicated to studying these majestic cats.

name: Waiting for the Out
summary:
Dan, a philosopher, begins teaching a class of men in prison. Each week, Dan leads discussions about dominance, freedom, luck and other topics that have troubled philosophers for thousands of years – topics that gain a new meaning when seen through the prisoners' eyes - both igniting passions and creating tension.

Through his work, Dan begins to dig deeper into his own past – growing up with a violent father who ended up in prison, as did his brother Lee and uncle Frank. Dan took a different path, but his time working in a prison begins to make him worry, obsessively, that he belongs behind bars just like his father. As Dan's personal crisis deepens, his actions begin to threaten both his own future, and his family's.

name: Secrets of the Brain
summary: Professor Jim Al-Khalili unravels the mysteries of arguably the most complex object in the cosmos: the human brain.

name: Taşacak Bu Deniz
summary: In a land where people are accustomed to battling fierce waves and constant storms, the story of a woman who stands tall on her feet, with all her emotional strength, resilience and endurance, and a man who is passionate about his "love" and who competes with the storms of the Black Sea and struggles with its waves, comes to the screens with an effective script... The ups and downs of the mountains, the sea and the human soul are told through the eyes of a stranger who finds himself in the middle of the endless war between two mortal enemies...

name: Jesse & Joy: Lo que nunca dijimos
summary: In this docuseries, Jesse & Joy open their hearts like never before, sharing the emotional journey, family wounds, and hidden truths that shaped both their identity and their music.

name: Ninja vs. Gokudo
summary: The ninja banish evil from the shadows. The gokudo gather lonely outcasts and commit crimes. The grudge they forged centuries ago is rekindled in the present day. The ninja Shinoha meets Kiwami, a gokudo with the face of a businessman. Unknowing of the other's identity, they bond over anime, but the war between ninja and gokudo intensifies. Who will survive and who will perish, ninja or gokudo?

name: Wo Zai Zhe Li Deng Ni
Taylor
summary:
Taylor will dig deep across the Taylor Swift's 20-year career, a period that has seen her transcend the realm of pop star to become a cultural icon like no other.

Through interviews with high-profile commentators, industry insiders and fans, the documentary examines the forces that have shaped her trajectory and the devoted community she has inspired. Rare archive will reveal fresh insights into Taylor and her story as the series charts her journey from ambitious teen with towering dreams to one of the most influential and scrutinised figures of our time.

name: Cases Between Us
summary: Two young men, Zhao Shaoshang and Yuan Hong, come from vastly different educational and family backgrounds. Through one case after another, they learn from each other and grow together. In a sweeping era of change, they become the most brilliant crime-fighting duo.

name: Tyst i klassen
summary: A shocking three-part docuseries centered on the discovery of child pornography tied to an international school in Karlstad, Sweden.

name: Ultimate Escape
summary: This is the ultimate search and rescue mission. Across 9 episodes, 10 everyday heroes battle time, extreme conditions, massive obstacles and each other to save a loved one.

name: Mystique in the Mirror
summary: Alan is trying to find the answers to who he was in the past and who he is now, every time he looks in the mirror, an old man appears. One day he meets Darwin, a young man who seems to be in the room next to Alan's in the mental health hospital. He's liked Alan since their first meeting.

name: В поиске себя
summary: The world is full of creative professions. The podcast is dedicated to representatives of these specialties, including artists of all kinds, from screen stars to stand-up comedians. In each episode, the host meets a person who has something to share about their work and life.

previousepisode.name: Как стать режиссером шоу? Стас Ильченко, Олег Титов, Слава Титов

name: Art's Most...
summary: Art critic Waldemar Januszczak explores three of art's most controversial and important subjects.

name: Рельсы счастья
summary: Each episode of the film is a flight, a meeting with new passengers, and therefore new destinies, new "life" stories, new problems that will be resolved before our eyes, right on the train...

name: E.B. White's Charlotte's Web
summary: A farm pig named Wilbur befriends a barn spider named Charlotte. When Wilbur learns he is being raised for slaughter, Charlotte writes messages praising him in her web in order to convince the farmer to let him live.

name: Grand Designs: Deconstructed
summary:
Hosted by broadcaster and self-confessed superfan, Greg James, each episode will premiere on More4 directly after the weekly broadcast of Grand Designs on Channel 4.

Each week, Greg James will sit down with Grand Designs host, Kevin McCloud to ask the questions viewers most want answered. Together, they'll reflect on the episode and take a deeper look at the build, with an informal and engaging exchange that brings out the detail and decision-making behind each project.

name: George Clarke's Homes in the Wild
summary: George Clarke's Homes in the Wild follows George as he embarks upon an epic journey to some of the hundreds of islands dotted around New Zealand's coastline and Australia's eastern seaboard on a quest to explore some of the countries' wildest homes. While meeting an array of colourful characters and navigating rugged terrain, George will discover just what it takes to reside and thrive in an offshore island home.

name: Bad Company
summary: Set within the crumbling walls of The Argyle, a venerable iconic theatre company on the brink of bankruptcy, Bad Company follows Margie, the Argyle's volatile artistic director, whose unchecked whims have sent the company spiraling, and Julia a high-flying corporate executive brought in to clean up Margie's mess.

name: Rendez-vous en terre inconnue
summary: A new outlook on a foreign group, whose culture and traditions are being threatened by the modern world.

previousepisode.name: Cyril Lignac chez les Gauchos sur île de Terre de Feu, au Chili

name: Vi kommer i fred
summary: A huge jellyfish-like object is seen over Stockholm and triggers global panic. Biologist Zandra Kraft realizes that it may be humanity's first contact with intelligent extraterrestrial life. Together with Prime Minister Moa Halmgren and crisis expert Elias Charbel, she must deal with hysteria, corruption and the threat of military intervention. In the roles we see Evin Ahmad, Fares Fares and Suzanne Reuter and others.

name: 50 Ways to Catch a Killer
summary: When killers think they've gotten away, the real game begins. 50 Cent hosts the ultimate true-crime series - where clever detectives outsmart ruthless killers, and justice comes with a twist.

name: Sahtekarlar
summary: A lawyer, a liar, a family consumed by the thirst for power... In this story where everyone hides their own truth, there is only one question: Who is the biggest fraud?

name: Anatomía de un instante
summary: Adolfo Suárez remained seated as coup plotters' bullets flew around him in Congress on February 23, 1981, while all MPs except Gutierrez Mellado and Carrillo hid under their seats.

name: Farzzle's World
summary: Worldviews from a baby's perspective.

name: Pumper Pups
summary: A light-hearted series involving a group of fire-fighting dogs narrated by Pumper, voiced by Leslie Nielsen.

name: Crazy Quilt
summary: Crazy Quilt is the tale of a quilt that takes viewers along for a learning adventure and craft creations in every episode. The hosts Maggie and Jackson teach kids to make crafts.

name: Treetown
summary: Treetown is the home of the playful Treetownies. Tansy, Rosabelle, and the Treetown toys invite viewers to play, sing, explore, and imagine with them.

name: Tipi Tales
summary: A Canadian First Nations family learns lessons and stories from their elderly grandfather and the animals around them, shared in the form of animated puppetry.

name: Bereketli Topraklar
summary: In Adana, the feud between the Bereketoğulları and Karahanlıs families reignites. As Ömer Bereketoğul struggles to protect his family and land, newly appointed prosecutor Nevin arrives, seeking justice for her fiancé's death. Their collision sparks a dangerous bond, where duty and desire clash and love becomes the most unpredictable weapon of all.

name: Камбэк
summary: He doesn't remember his name, who he is or where he came from, but one day he woke up in the hospital with multiple injuries and no memory. Now he is forced to wander around the city, sleep where he has to, and eat what he is given, but at the same time he has not lost his human appearance and dignity, as much as possible under the circumstances. The children called him Compote because of his special love for the drink from their school cafeteria, where he is fed by a compassionate cook. A group of high school friends decides to help Compote, find out the truth and try to bring back his real life, but "completing this quest and finding the key" turns out to be quite difficult.…

name: O'ahu Shores
summary: In Hawaii, the word "ohana" means family and for this bold, vibrant and tight-knit group of friends, they love and argue just like family. These young Hawaiian locals are stepping out of their parents' expectations and carving their own paths while still embracing their culture. As they navigate love, face heartbreak and test friendship loyalties, this group proves life on the island has just as much shade as there is sun.

name: Du Xin Lao Gong You Dian Tian
The Tower of Whispers
summary: After an unjust death at the hands of the tyrannical Emperor Jun Che, Lu Yingying, the daughter of a disgraced Minister of Rites, is miraculously reborn before the tragedies unfold. Vowing to change her destiny, she seeks out Jun Che when he is still a convict and buys him, becoming his master...

name: Rescued The Lost Times
summary: In the 14th year of Tang Tianbao, the An Shi Rebellion broke out. The emperor fled west, leaving the eunuch Chen Jingbian in sole control of Chang'an. Possessing the Night Firefly Map, which holds the secrets of the realm's most powerful figures after their deaths, Chen becomes the target of spies from all directions. At this critical moment, Feng Yinniang, the daughter of a military family, ventures alone into Chang'an. Disguised as a healer, she approaches Chen Jingbian, seeking to seize the Night Firefly Map and uncover the mastermind behind the conspiracy that destroyed her family.

name: The Killings at Parrish Station
summary:
It's 1987, and Detective Georgia Cooke is called in to investigate the massacre of four scientists who have been brutally murdered in inexplicable ways, with a lone survivor the obvious suspect. But as Georgia digs deeper, unravelling a complex case entangled in mania, ritual, and the occult, her obsessive quest for the truth spirals into a nightmare that will put her family, career, and sanity on the line. 

37 years later, a chilling new spree of murders will pull Georgia back into this nightmare as she confronts the terrifying possibility that the horrors at Parrish Station were never fully buried.

name: Montmartre
summary: In 1899, Céleste, a can-can dancer in a Montmartre cabaret, desperately tries to find the brother and sister from whom she was brutally separated as a child when their father was murdered before their eyes. To pay Léon, the inspector tasked with finding them, she has no choice but to become Paris's first stripper. Arsène, a young automobile engineer from the wealthy neighborhoods, is preparing to take over the reins of his father's factory. Engaged, he cannot bring himself to marry even though he secretly loves men. He then takes the risk of opposing his father and suddenly breaks off his engagement. Rose, a young laundress from the suburbs, deeply in love, is preparing to start a family with her fiancé. But her dream is short-lived when he actually leads her to a brothel where she is locked up. Rose manages to escape, but pursued by her pimps, she throws herself into the Marne and finds herself between life and death. None of our three heroes realizes that blood ties connect them.

name: Potions Will Save Me
summary: Kaede, an ordinary high school girl, wakes up in an unfamiliar alleyway. It is a mysterious another filled with beastmen, elves, and dragons. Kaede noticed an unfamiliar book in the backpack she was carrying. It was a mysterious book that could create potions simply by chanting the word "creation"! For Kaede, who had been thrust into this another world, the potions she created became the sustenance that supported her life. While hoping to one day return to Japan, her struggles in this another world continue

name: Hands off: Sawaranaide Kotesashi-kun
summary: Koyo Kotesashi is a first-year high school student with a special talent for giving massages. He takes a job as the dorm manager at Seiwa University High School, known for its athletes, to help pay for his tuition. Determined to earn a special scholarship to the medical department, Koyo dedicates himself to taking care of the players' bodies and minds. Wildly over the top, yet irresistibly pure!

name: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle
summary: Saku Chitose is a student at Fujishi High School, the most prestigious school in Fukui Prefecture. Outstanding in class, on the field, and in his social life, Saku attracts attention, good and bad. Naturally, he is surrounded by a circle of friends anyone would be happy to have. Now in the spring of his second year, with a new class, Saku is asked to help a shut-in classmate return to school life.

name: Ganglion
summary: The series follows Kenji Isobe, who works for the Ganglion company. Also known as Belve, he spends his days helping the company attain world domination. However, he has to fight opponents such as the hero Hopeman, who aim to bring justice to the world and defeat Belve and the others.

name: Premium Rush: Inside Air Cargo Singapore
summary:
Singapore Changi Airport is world-renowned for its passenger terminals, but how many people know it's also one of the busiest air cargo hubs in the world as it processes over 1.5 million tonnes of goods? 

From horses and ornamental fish to fresh cherries and flowers, Premium Rush: Inside Air Cargo Singapore gives you exclusive access into the hidden world of Changi Airport's airfreight operations, as we follow some amazing journeys.

name: A Week Away: The Series
summary: At Camp Aweegaway, a Christian summer camp filled with adventure and camaraderie, kids come together for experiences that challenge and inspire them. Between team-building competitions, campfires, and heartfelt conversations, they form deep friendships and uncover new layers of their faith and identity. Each day at camp offers opportunities for growth, connection, and unforgettable memories.

name: Rapport fra Nr. 24
summary: A three episodes documentary about the most decorated war hero in Norway, the young Gunnar "Kjakan" Sønsteby (Code named "No. 24") and his life as an undercover agent during the second world war. We follow the story in his own words, telling about his upbringing in the town of Rjukan where he and a lot of his fellow class mates become some of the second World wars most important saboteurs and resistance men against the German war machine. We follow his work as a cob web spinner during the war in Oslo, while being a student, until the successful end of the war as one of the most trusted by the Norwegian government.

name: Kammattam
summary: Inspector Antonio George smells foul play in the mysterious death of Samuel Umman. As his investigation leads him to Samuel's employee, Francis, Antonio realizes that a much larger game is in play.

name: The Chronicles of the 4.5 Gang
summary: The five protagonists, one among them being a dwarf hailing from a slum, as they venture into the flower mafia around temples and other odd businesses to gain the respect of the public.

name: Homestuck
summary: Animated adaptation of the famous Internet multimedia series of the same name.

name: The Last Wright: Building the Final Home Design of America's Greatest Architect
summary: The four-part limited series follows mother-daughter team Debbie Dykstra and Sarah Dykstra as they take on the ambitious challenge of building a home based on the last set of plans created by legendary architect Frank Lloyd Wright before his death in 1959. Executive produced by Chip and Joanna Gaines, The Last Wright offers an unprecedented look at the intersection of timeless design and modern construction.

name: Know It All Nina
summary: Know it all nina is a popular web series on dream works tv on YouTube, Jenna Ortega plays lead role of Nina that thinks she knows everything people are free to tweet questions that Nina will answer but at the end they out smart her.

name: RIV4LI
summary: At a middle school in Pisa, no one has ever challenged the cool kids — until new girl Terry arrives with bold ideas and the rivalries begin.

name: Alphamännchen
summary: Four close-knit friends in their 40s do their best to face a new world of modern masculinity — but even their best tends to make things worse.

name: The Game: You Never Play Alone
summary: A career-driven game developer fights back against misogynistic expectations after she becomes the target of brutal attacks online and in real life.

name: Обнальщик
summary: In 2013, young Lyosha almost achieved what he had dreamed of since childhood.: his cryptocurrency trading startup is about to open the doors to China for him. However, fate abruptly changes course. The whole family suddenly moves to a small town in the Far East — Lyosha's father, Mikhail, expects to start a new business there. The plans are ruined when the shocking truth is revealed: Mikhail has huge debts, and bandits are on the trail of the family. When it seems that there is no way out, Mikhail learns about his son's technological development and decides to use it to earn money. So, risking everything, the father and son begin to transfer huge sums of money into cash for criminal structures. Their lives are turning into a dangerous game where freedom is at stake, and the stakes are getting higher every day.

name: Linde på Langeland
summary: Sofie Linde and her family have fallen in love with an old haunted house on Langeland and are moving the whole family to the island. With the help of her faithful handymen, twins Anders and Philip, Sofie Linde wants to transform the dilapidated house into a dream of a summer home.

name: Peach Trap
summary: At that moment when Yoo Do Ha is in the biggest crisis of his life, three men approach him! He gets caught up in a storm of love signals with each of the three men. Even at the same time! A whirlwind of fate that centers around Do Ha. Who will the final love stick be directed towards?! A cheerful and lively romantic comedy depicting the process of finding a boyfriend.

name: My Little Ghost
summary: A young architecture student ends up living with an amnesiac ghost. As they search for the lost pieces of the past, an invisible bond of care and love grows—only to be tested by the unbridgeable boundary between life and death.

name: Fragrance of the Pomegranates
summary: Ming Liang, an art school graduate, foregoes advanced education to take over the Red Pomegranate restaurant for his ailing foster mother. He overcomes numerous obstacles and elevates it into a quality dining venue. This experience fuels both his personal growth and artistic development. During this time, he reconnects with his fiercely independent childhood friend Gulina'er. Supporting and growing together, they evolve into lovers and deeply aligned companions.

name: Zhong Wu Yan Zhi Qing Shi Wu Shuang
Nice to Not Meet You
summary: A romantic comedy about an actor who plays the roles of detectives and wants to become a master of romcoms, and a former political reporter who has fallen from grace to entertainment journalism.

name: A Lifetime of Military Service
summary: After losing her memory in a betrayal, General Mo Lingyue starts a new life under the name Shang Yueqing, only to be framed by her husband Liu Shifei and his allies. When her memories return, she joins forces with the crown prince Xie Changyan to expose a royal conspiracy and reclaim justice for her fallen comrades.

name: Coming Out of The Mountains, She Becam a Food God, But She Became a Vegetable Delivery Girl
A Bungling Undercover Agent Mistakes the CEO for a Crime Boss
Strange Chronicles of Tang: The Chang'an Detective
Fatal Engineering
summary: Fatal Engineering meticulously dissects high-profile accidents, uncovering the human errors, design flaws, and unforeseen circumstances that led to devastating outcomes. Each episode unravels the science behind the disaster, analyzing blueprints and engineering decisions to pinpoint the fatal moment. Was the tragedy preventable, or was it inevitable? Through expert insights, the series transforms complex technical details into accessible, compelling narratives. These investigations reveal hard-earned lessons and explore the lasting impact of each incident. Fatal Engineering clears the debris to expose the truth, asking: Why did it happen? What did we learn? And how can we ensure it never happens again?

name: Kassa Kassa
summary: Kassa Kassa is a tragicomic series set in the Stans brothers' supermarket, a small, independent neighborhood convenience store on the verge of bankruptcy. The colleagues form a close-knit, warm group of friends, but their well-intentioned actions often complicate matters.

name: Луана
summary: Luana has many fascinating and funny stories to tell: she was almost set on fire by a neighbor, visited a strange dentist, and studied with the most evil teacher. She also has unusual friends, talking vegetables Potato and Marco. Together, they come up with new challenges and funny pranks every day that test your courage and resourcefulness.

name: Hammasiga Istanbul aybdor
summary: Fatima misses the wedding and asks her twin sister to marry her instead. A series about love and duty.

name: Пари с Ларионовым
summary: Renowned athletes past and present share personal stories, memories, and perspectives on the game.

name: #ЛавСтайл
summary: Exclusive reports from the world's fashion capitals, private parties, behind-the-scenes looks from fashion shows, celebrity interviews, and the secrets of unique star looks. Plus, handmade creations from top designers, an interactive show with viewers, stylish new music and tech gadgets! Everything you ever wanted to know about fashion and more! Our hosts—true trendsetters Masha Wei, Valerie, Nastya Smirnova, and Zaur Gazdarov—will become your best friends and share their secrets to success! They run their popular blogs, travel from continent to continent for the latest fashion events, speak several languages fluently, and interact with Russian and international celebrities. Become a style icon with us!

name: Life & The Earth
summary: The history of the Earth, and the life it holds, is fascinating. Life and The Earth is a series dedicated to exploring its history.

previousepisode.name: Why do Millions of Sea Creatures Rise at Night?

name: Bijo ka Yajuu
summary: This drama pits two protagonists against each other. On the one hand there's Makoto, a woman who believes that the TV program is a product and that viewer ratings are the proceeds, and who believes any method is fair in getting those ratings. On the other hand there's Hiromi, a flashy sort of guy who claims that life is to enjoy and boasts that the program is simply a tool in that process. He loves wine, women and gambling. Such a pair is bound to mix like oil and water, but following a fateful reunion, they come to understand each other in the midst of confrontation.

name: All Heart: A Rugby Story
summary: A culmination of years of sacrifice, hard work, and preparation, the series follows Canada's women's national rugby team as they pursue a history-making campaign to win Women's Rugby World Cup 2025. Through unprecedented access provided by the partnership with Rugby Canada and World Rugby, viewers can witness a story of raw conviction and self-belief that transcends the sport.

name: Black Girl Missing
summary: The Black Girl Missing franchise consists of Lifetime movies that highlight the media and societal disparities in the attention given to missing Black women and girls.

name: Oh Eun Young's Report: Marriage Hell
When The War Is Over
summary:
Across five episodes, Rachel explores the game-changing songs, iconic paintings, blockbuster films, best-selling books, jaw-dropping artworks and spine-tingling performances that have helped transform Australians' understanding of our five major wars: World War I, World War II, Vietnam, Afghanistan and the Australian Wars.

A descendent of WWI veterans at Gallipoli, Rachel visits key battlegrounds across the globe – in Türkiye, Vietnam and Thailand. Back in Australia, she meets artists, veterans, curators and historians, exploring the unheralded role of art in war, both in the midst of battle and for the generations that follow. From Jimmy Barnes belting out Khe Sanh to Ben Quilty's haunting portraits of Afghanistan war veterans, this is a richly layered series about the real-world impact of art on all of us, on both a personal and national level.

When The War Is Over is a provocative and moving examination of how art challenges our myths, memorialises trauma, and redefines heroism, and importantly, the series confronts the legacy of the Australian Wars, an often-overlooked chapter in Australia's war history.

name: Hollywood Hustler: Glitz, Glam, Scam
summary:
Hollywood Hustler: Glitz, Glam, Scam the series chronicles the meteoric rise and catastrophic fall of Zach Horwitz, an aspiring actor described by friends as obsessed with achieving A-list status, as he orchestrates one of Hollywood's most audacious financial frauds. 

From Indiana to Los Angeles, the series unravels how Zach, an aspiring actor, constructed an elaborate Ponzi scheme to finance his relentless pursuit of Hollywood fame, creating a persona of wealth and success through fake connections to powerful CEOs and industry executives. After establishing the façade of a successful Hollywood company, he attracted wealthy investors while funding his lavish lifestyle of luxury cars, courtside seats, and a $5.7 million home—all while attempting to buy his way into an acting career.

name: The Ascent of Ling Yun
summary: Palace maid Ling Yun infiltrates the imperial harem as bait, becoming a favored consort. She uses her position to expose the shocking corruption of the most powerful imperial consort. However, her success comes at a great cost. Now, she is trapped in a deadly web of court intrigue and a forbidden, unrequited love with her brother. Can she emerge unscathed from the carnage and seize a chance at redemption?

name: Millionaire Hot Seat
summary: Millionaire Hot Seat will see six everyday Aussies hoping to take their place in the hot seat each episode, facing a series of 15 challenging questions for the chance to walk away with up to $1,000,000 - all under Rebecca's expert guidance.

name: Бессонница
summary: Investigator Dasha and highly skilled professional Denis meet during group therapy for insomnia, a condition they both have long suffered from. This is the only thing they have in common, as Dasha is a perfectionist and an excellent student, while Denis is a slacker and a hard worker. Denis devotes his sleepless nights to a deep understanding of various areas of human activity, and Dasha realizes that no one can help her with a specific investigation better than Denis.

name: María, Mother of God
summary: The 25-episode vertical series reimagine one of the Bible's most iconic love stories for a new generation.

name: I'm Not a Casual Person
summary: After being canceled by the entire internet, D-list "vase" actress Zheng Ying lives by one motto: just go with the flow. But everything changes when she saves Shen Yifan — a cold, sharp-tongued genius investor with a heart condition. He controls everything… except her carefree attitude! As Shen Yifan's life ticks down, Zheng Ying slacks off while he tears down her excuses; she plays dead while he turns the tables. What starts as a dying man's attempt to repay a debt quietly turns into a dangerous game of hearts. When the scandal-ridden "queen of black press" makes her ultimate comeback and the stoic genius falls under her spell, the two join forces — proving that living with purpose can set the whole entertainment industry ablaze!

name: Ferry of Souls
summary: A mysterious monster inn hides quietly within the bustling city, accessible only to those destined to visit. Shouguan Feiye, a monster hunter, becomes trapped in the inn for a thousand years, neither aging nor dying, after being cursed by the vengeful spirits of the monsters he has slain. To break the curse, he is forced to bring back Dongfang Zhaobai, the former innkeeper who has lost his memory. Meanwhile, other guests with unresolved ties to the two gradually arrive at the inn, each carrying lingering regrets or unfinished emotional burdens. As they help these guests release their obsessions, Shouguan Feiye rediscovers long-lost human emotions, and Dongfang gradually softens his rigid view of monsters. In the end, the two join forces to defeat the mastermind Monster King, restoring peace to the world, resolving a centuries-old misunderstanding between them, and falling in love with each other once again through their shared journey.

name: Abyss
summary: The long-standing peace of a conservative small town is shattered by the appearance of an online novel "Abyss." Many plot points bear a striking resemblance to a cold case from years ago that has never been made public. Li Cheng, a passionate and righteous rookie police officer, engages in a series of high-stakes battles of wits with various suspects. He unravels the mystery, revealing the truth buried beneath heartbreaking kinships and friendships.

name: The Cursed Love
summary: Young model and billionaire Siwat embarks on a secret quest to get rid of his uncontrollable fire powers, which are tied to his heartbeat and have already cost him dearly. His only hope lies in the legendary Heart of Divine Magic hidden deep within the ancient lost city of Tambralinga. The journey pits him against Khunkhao, a wind-controlling mountain rescuer who knows the city's secrets and wants them buried forever, forcing both men to confront ancient curses, magical rivalries, and a love that could rewrite history.

name: The Home Front
summary: Drama series about the internal tensions behind the facade of a northern English family.

name: Heartland
summary: A series of plays concerning the theme of love.

name: Man of Straw
summary: A politically ambitious and sycophantic man from a German provincial town rises to power by adopting the authoritarian and nationalist ideals of the Wilhelmine era.

name: Goodnight and God Bless
summary:
Former Butlin's Red Coat and stand-up comedian Ronnie Kemp, who now hosted a top-rated television quiz show called Keeping Up With The Jones's.

He was loved by millions for his on-screen persona and had a Rolls-Royce and a driver called Harry, and a house with three acres in the stockbroker belt, but he was still deeply unhappy.

When he heard that his ex-wife Audrey was remarrying, Ronnie danced for joy. With the thought of not having to pay any more alimony, he threw caution to the wind and forced money on his beautiful new wife, Celia, and her father, Geoffrey, in a bout of uncharacteristic generosity. His joy was short-lived when he discovered Audrey had not finished wth him yet.

name: Huanggu En Chou Lu: Po Feng Pian
Somm Street
summary: Jermaine Stone is the Street Somm. From street eats to comfort food to Michelin-starred masterpieces; Jermaine's mission is to prove there's no "right" way to pair wine.

name: Prisoner 951
summary:
Prisoner 951 follows the story of Nazanin Zaghari-Ratcliffe, a British-Iranian citizen who was detained in Iran for six years, and her husband Richard Ratcliffe who campaigned tirelessly for her return.

The series covers the period from the day Nazanin was arrested at the airport in Tehran to her release and return to the UK six years later.

name: Weapons That Made Britain
summary: Documentary series looking at the development of weapons and military hardware throughout history.

name: Band of Spies
summary: In the aftermath of the massacre at the 1972 Munich Olympic Games, BAND OF SPIES follows Israeli Mossad agents as they hunt down members of the Black September terrorist group. As the investigation progresses, it consumes the lives of both the agents and their targets as they unknowingly change the face of global politics.

name: Habibi Baba Boom
summary: Sami, a German-Egyptian tax consultant, has been coping with life more badly than well since his Jette left him. He hopes to win back her heart together with their their joint shop "Tattoos & Taxes" at all costs. To raise the money, he secures a new client: Suma, a Turkish restaurant owner. But she will only hire him if he's a devout Muslim. So Sami, who turned his back on Islam, plays along. Thus, putting on this act launches a turbulent journey back to his own roots.

name: Am I The A**hole?
summary: In this unfiltered new panel show, Jimmy Carr is joined by internet sensation GK Barry and acclaimed stand-up Jamali Maddix to judge an array of questionable characters and their equally questionable choices.

previousepisode.name: Radioactive Revenge and a Ruined Christmas

name: I Kill The Bear
summary: I Kill The Bear is a comedy about a family of bear wranglers for film sets, and why – after 100 years – they've decided to make this film their last.

name: ПинКод 2.0
summary:
Smeshariki enter a virtual reality—dangerous and beautiful. Educational adventures of beloved characters.

Following the experiments of a notorious horned scientist, the Kikoriki find themselves in a virtual simulation of their world, which turns out to be a vast Metaverse. Together with the artificial intelligence Eva, the friends decide to explore this new world, experimenting with and studying the technologies of the future. It soon becomes clear that the Metaverse holds many mysteries, and escaping it isn't so easy.

name: naked
summary: Luis loves Marie — but is addicted to sex. And Marie is addicted to Luis. What begins as burning passion transforms into a dangerous vortex of desire, dependence, and pain. naked peers mercilessly into hidden, deeply human abysses.

name: Prescott: The Class System and Me
summary: John Prescott embarks on a journey through the British class system to see if class still exists, meeting people from across the social spectrum to eye-opening effect.

name: Zoomers
summary: After a personal tragedy, 18-year-old Javi starts university determined to follow a list to bring order to his life and control his anxiety. But with his new friends at the dorm, he discovers that neither love nor friendship can be planned. Amid chaos, dark humor, and unexpected experiences, he embarks on a journey of self-discovery.

name: Rurouni Kenshin: Meiji Kenkaku Romantan - Seisou-hen
summary:
Kaoru goes to the harbor every day to see if Kenshin has returned. After a while, she starts looking back at her life with Kenshin and all the things that have happened.

This two-part OVA series is a sequel to the original anime.

name: Rurouni Kenshin: Meiji Kenkaku Romantan - Shin Kyoto-hen
summary:
A large scale remake of the time after Kenshin leaves Tokyo up until before the inferno of Kyoto.

This two-part OVA series is a remake of Kyoto Arc from the original series.

name: La suerte
summary: Quite by chance, David crosses Spain with a bullfighter and his group, forging a great friendship.

previousepisode.name: A Madrid no se le dice que no

name: Sunday Night Thriller
summary: Collection of four thrillers.

name: G.R.I.T.S.
summary: G.R.I.T.S follows Keisha, Ty and Francis, three young women from the unforgiving city of Memphis who are determined to figure out the next chapter in their lives while relishing in the world of their favorite past time, roller skating. They dream of leaving Memphis one day for the big city Hollywood life but their soul ties make leaving good ole' soul food loving, turbulent, southernly-charming, bible-thumping Memphis damn near impossible. When all else fails, skate until you can't skate anymore.

name: Interminable
summary: The love between lord Khun Yai and Kaewta, a traditional Thai dancer, remained unfulfilled, leading to a tragedy that hindered Khun Yai's soul from being reborn. In Kaewta's new life, he encounters the ancient Thai house inhabited by the owner's spirit. Memories of the past come to the surface.

name: Färjan
summary: Every night, all through the year, 1 200 passengers board Baltic Charisma for a cruise between Sweden and Finland. But tonight there is something evil on board the ship, and there is nowhere to escape.

name: Love Reset
summary: TRUE FILM's second BL web drama, 'Love Reset'.

name: The Celebrity Inner Circle
summary: Amanda Holden hosts the gripping, high-stakes quiz where celebs and contestants must outsmart each other to win big. It's not just what you know - it's who can you trust?

name: The Essex Murders: Who Killed Goldfinger?
summary:
June 24, 2015. A quiet, secluded Essex garden. John "Goldfinger" Palmer, once one of Britain's richest and most feared gangsters, lies dead.

At first, police attending the scene think it's nothing suspicious. Six days later came the bombshell revelation , Palmer had been shot six times. There were no witnesses and the killer left no forensic trail. This was an underworld murder that shocked the world and left the global press asking, "Who killed Goldfinger?"

Now, 10 years on from that fateful day and with police no closer to solving Palmer's murder, this gripping Sky Documentaries series will re-examine his death and investigate the multiple theories that still linger to this day on why he was killed.

Across three propulsive episodes The Essex Murders: Who Killed Goldfinger? will take viewers on a dark journey through the changing face of crime over a thirty-year period from the zenith of 80s armed robbery, The Brink's-Mat gold heist, through to the sun-soaked 90s timeshare scam that would offer Palmer untold riches but also bring him into dangerous contact with the Russian mafia and then through to today's global narco-traffickers and the shadowy world of international assassins.

name: Trace, Track, Get My Car Back
summary: Real crime, real recovery. The specialist teams taking on the UK's car crime crisis - using hi-tech trackers to hunt down stolen vehicles and swipe them back for their owners.

name: The Inner Circle
summary: Amanda Holden hosts the gripping, high-stakes quiz where players must outsmart each other to win big. It's not just what you know - it's who can you trust?

name: Jim Jefferies & Friends
summary: Jim Jefferies steps into his own stand-up comedy show, Jim Jefferies And Friends.

name: Cards and Collectibles Australia
summary: From rare sports cards to gaming, autographs, toys, cars, movie props and more, each episode showcases the unique collections and the individuals behind them.

name: The Dream Life of Mr. Kim
summary: A drama that tells the story of a middle-aged man who loses everything he thought was valuable in an instant and, after a long journey, finally discovers his true self, beyond his role as a manager at a large corporation.

name: The Body
summary: After a dance-team initiation goes wrong, a group of badly behaved Catholic school girls begin having prophetic visions that set off mass hysteria in their town.

name: Punchlines
summary: Punchlines is a game where eight celebrities each have a punchline, and contestants have to match the correct response to each question.

name: Murder Down Under: The Toolbox Murders
summary: This true-crime documentary plunges into the tragic events of January 24, 2016, unravelling the double murder of 28-year-old Corey Breton, and 31-year-old Iuliana Triscaru.

name: Murder in Mind
summary:
Murder in Mind is a groundbreaking new series that examines the psychological themes that drive people to kill.

Murder can never be justified. This is a journey of explanation, not excuse.

Following one case, as a single narrative in each episode, investigators, friends, and family of the perpetrator unpick what happened in the murderer's life and how a combination of adverse experiences might have escalated into bad decision making, resulting in a violent and fatal conclusion.  

Murder in Mind picks up on the appetite for popular psychology and seeks to understand why most of us are sheltered from the triggers that drive some beyond restraint.

name: Pride Rules
summary:
Pride Rules takes audiences on a journey that reveals how iconic lion prides survive and thrive in the Chobe region of Botswana.

Stunning cinematography brings epic African vistas to life and showcases the extraordinary story of the Chobe prides—a powerful representation of the lion species as a whole. Across an ever-evolving landscape dictated by seasonal change, these lions are forced to battle it out against the elements in their quest for survival.

Against the backdrop of their environmental challenges, the series examines the intricacies of pride dynamics as the resident lions grapple with pride politics, both internally and when facing rival prides in the territory.

name: Social Media Monsters
summary: Social Media Monsters examines serious crimes where social media played a significant role, meeting victims, friends and families, and gaining insight from police, psychologists and other experts.

name: Idol Kids Philippines
summary: Idol Kids Philippines is the newest and biggest singing competition for young talents, featuring a powerhouse lineup of judges made up of four of this generation's biggest OPM stars.

name: Lucky Dog: Down Under
summary: Host Brandon McMillan showcases the heartwarming stories of Australian shelter dogs as they transition from rescue and rehabilitation to cherished members of loving families. Whether it's a scrappy terrier, an energetic kelpie or a partially deaf cattle dog, audiences discover that second chances can transform lives on both ends of the leash. This original series is based on the hit international format "The Dog House Australia."

name: Ghar Waapsi
summary: The life of Shekhar, who is out of work, changes forever as he moves back to his hometown and finds a road to self-discovery.

name: Tiltalt
summary: Five celebrities are to judge a murder case. Will they be able to agree on a verdict?

name: Rampenissen
summary: This year's Christmas Advent Calendar on TV 2: 25 celebrities will compete against each other, but a cunning mischievous elf gives the participants challenging tasks. Little do they know that a secret three-leaf clover controls the mischievous elf.

name: Kurukshetra
summary: One war, 18 days, 18 perspectives. Follow two families as they engage in an expansive and legendary clash for power, honor and revenge.

name: Euphorie
summary: 16-year-old Mila returns from a psychiatric facility after a misunderstood incident. She finds herself caught in a love triangle between her crush Ali and troubled actor Jannis, spiraling into a dangerous world of drugs and violence.

name: Object Z Returns
summary: Professor Ramsay is released from prison in time to help with three more mysterious objects on a collision course with the Earth. But this time it's not a rogue meteor – it's a fleet of invading alien ships.

name: Xiao Xian Zhi Yao Vertical Version
summary: This is a version of the main show released by iQIYI that is cut for vertical video and edited down for shorter form content.

name: Чебурашка
summary: This time Cheburashka and his faithful friend Crocodile Gena decide to become real helpers to all the neighbors of the cozy town where they live. The guys decide to open a "Bureau of Good Deeds" — a place where everyone can come with their request, whether it's fixing a broken thing, helping with their studies, or even finding new friends. Of course, their decisions are not always perfect and sometimes lead to funny situations, but sincerity and a desire to support make friends truly irreplaceable. However, a peaceful undertaking immediately faces an opponent — the cunning and restless Shapoklyak. She organizes a "Bureau of evil Deeds" to put sticks in the wheels of Cheburashka and Gene. Her pranks turn each episode into a small battle of kindness and mischief, where the most important thing is not victory, but the ability to remain honest, friendly and believe in the power of fantasy.
